name: write_file
description: Write content to a file, replacing its entire contents (no append/merge); returns the absolute path. Writable roots include the working directory (or configured roots) and the session/system temp dirs; temp=true writes under the per-session temp dir. Paths outside them are rejected with `Write blocked`. Sensitive paths/names such as `.ssh/`, `.aws/`, `.npmrc`, and `config.json` are rejected even with temp=true.

file_path.description: Absolute or working-directory-relative when temp=false; relative filename when temp=true (absolute paths rejected).

content.description: Full file content to write (overwrites existing file).

temp.description: Write under the per-session temp directory for scratch/intermediate files (scripts, data dumps, fixtures); only the basename is kept; cleaned up when the session ends. (default: false)
